status: authored feasibility scenario; parameters are not observations or climate predictions

C1.150_to_66Ma: Divergent rift margins; newly emergent lobes require marginal continental basement
C1.66_to_5Ma: Accretion and foreland subsidence build a curved convergent margin
C1.by_2Ma: Interior drainage, western mountain rim and approach plains precede early settlement
C1.constraint: Do not infer terrestrial access from a plate boundary or nucleus point

C2.older_than_150Ma: Inherited shield and marginal basement before paired-ocean opening
C2.150_to_66Ma: Asymmetric rifting and submerged outer basins replace the long taper
C2.66_to_5Ma: Oblique active-margin highlands and east-draining foreland develop
C2.by_2Ma: Hinge and highland-headwater continuity required; no extra rigid six-degree offset
C2.constraint: New western mountain axis must follow the shortened body, not the old atlas axis

C3.older_than_150Ma: Composite continent; constituent blocks retain separate collision ancestries
C3.150_to_66Ma: Rift embayments and terrane docking modify external peninsulas
C3.66_to_5Ma: Inherited southern collisions and later interior uplift establish west/east habitat filters
C3.by_2Ma: Mainland route to shelf cradle and external gateway exists
C3.constraint: The eastern core rotation is not a rotation of the whole composite continent

C4.older_than_150Ma: Inherited polar-continent nuclei; earlier polar occupancy varies with frame
C4.150_to_66Ma: Peripheral stretching and subsidence create embayments
C4.66_to_5Ma: High-latitude core; progressive glaciation conditional on forcing; western arc accretes 15–8 Ma
C4.by_2Ma: Western neck emerged by 6 Ma; low-relief coastal plain and peripheral refuges selected
C4.constraint: Closing the western marine gateway changes circulation; retain other marine outlets

C5.older_than_150Ma: Inherited continental basement and breakup neighborhood
C5.150_to_66Ma: Asymmetric extension changes outline and leaves submerged marginal crust
C5.66_to_5Ma: Outer-margin subsidence; highland collision and arc accretion
C5.by_2Ma: Shelf-arc fragments emerge by 3–5 Ma and foothill relief by 3 Ma
C5.constraint: Shortened crossings remain water barriers; arrival is not proof of viable colonization

C6.older_than_150Ma: Inherited continental core, not a permanently equatorial refuge
C6.150_to_66Ma: Inherited breakup order with alternative marginal subsidence
C6.66_to_5Ma: Increasing low-latitude exposure and island separation; forest expansion conditional on rainfall
C6.by_2Ma: Distinct watershed and endemic-island histories remain required
C6.constraint: No specific fauna assigned an invented Earth-like fossil history

gateways.notes: Possible exposure at deep lowstands; no actual opening timetable or founder rate inferred
Forearc accretion 15–8 Ma and emergence by 6 Ma; a new western terrestrial substitute, not use of the old cold exit
Repeated relative sea-level changes allow connection and fragmentation; selected platform has older carbonate substrate
Tectonic channels stay marine; widths require a mapped route, not an assumed universal safe distance
Arc consolidation 12–5 Ma; broad valley passes exist by 3.5 Ma; volcanic activity does not eliminate all refuge nodes
Foothills and older arc substrate predate occupation; this is a route low point, not peak mountain height
Do not replace deep barrier with a shallow causeway when making H-E access easier
Island age and terrain remain independent requirements

ancestral_substitution.replacement: western forearc neck and coast from native roughly 42S to western continental core
ancestral_substitution.formation: accretion 15–8 Ma; continuous bedrock emerged by 6 Ma
ancestral_substitution.ecology: maritime lowland shrub/woodland, riparian refuges and seasonal resources are required hypotheses
ancestral_substitution.isolation: ancestral dispersal allowed; later west/east population boundaries remain ecological and demographic, not universal water barriers
ancestral_substitution.ocean_consequence: western marine closure must be tested with retained eastern outlets; no assumption of unchanged Mediterranean-like circulation
